title: PodShip
tagline: PodShip is a Decentralized Podcast Sharing & Streaming Platform. With the power of NFTs, it empowers podcasters to take control of their content and monetize their creations. #PodcastNFTs
description:
Podcasters create so much value in our lives with their podcasts but in return, many of the podcasters don't get enough benefits especially financially. In fact, some of the podcast channels have negative cash flows. Users, who provide their valuable time to the platforms, don’t get many benefits from it instead Web2 platforms don’t respect their Users’ Data & Privacy. PodShip's main goal is to support Podcasters & Give Users Full Data Privacy

PodShip empowers Podcasters to upload their podcasts over a decentralized Internet and mint it as an NFT. Podcasters then can sell their Podcasts NFTs using PodShip thru Auctions. PodShip provides Podcasters & Users with an easy, fast & reliable Value-For-Value framework. With the help of that framework, Podcasters can receive seamless and direct tips from their fans using the Tipping Functionality. 

Follow us on Twitter @PodShipNFT

Note: PodShip Project is on 4-5 GitHub Repos.
PodShip Github organization: https://github.com/PodShip
how_its_made: The Dapp front-end is built using Next.js. We used Hardhat for Smart Contracts development and FVM deployment. We are storing Podcast NFTs metadata on IPFS/Filecoin using NFT.storage. To notify our users about new podcasts, we are using Push Protocol services. We are using subgraphs from the TheGraph protocol to index data entities from the blockchain.
